description: This Java class defines a size validator for policy commands in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It ensures that policy commands do not exceed a configured maximum size in bytes, using a singleton pattern for instantiation, and throws a specific exception when the size limit is exceeded.

classes.name: PolicyCommandSizeValidator
classes.description: A final class responsible for validating the size of policy commands, extending the generic AbstractCommandSizeValidator with a specific exception type.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PolicyCommandSizeValidator, initializing it on the first call based on system parameter.

methods.name: newInvalidSizeException
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyTooLargeException when the command size exceeds the maximum allowed.
